# Synthetic Note A

Identity: `pr04-note-a`; controlling version: `v1 (2026-10-15)`.
This is an authored, public engineering fixture, not an actual literature claim.

## Theorem 1.1

For every real number x, x squared is nonnegative. Proof: if x is nonnegative,
x times x is nonnegative; otherwise both factors are negative and their product
is positive. The sole hypothesis is x real.

## Example 1.2

At x = 3, x squared equals 9.

## Problem 1.3

Prove that the square of an integer is nonnegative.

## Conjecture 1.4

For every nonnegative real t, t squared plus 2t is nonnegative.
This fixture presents the statement as a proposed extension, not as a proof input.

## Version warning

A hypothetical v0 statement restricted x to integers. It is not the controlling
version and cannot support an unchanged claim about every real x.
